title: A sprint worker's /kb-verify run does not run tests.py --changed, which its brief forbids
goal: /kb-verify and the kb-worker role agree on the suite a sprint worker runs: a worker following .claude/agents/kb-worker.md and /kb-verify never runs tests.py --changed (the landing's sync gate runs it), so the brief's rule and the skill no longer contradict (SP-flkl5gom close: workers of ST-uy4d752n and ST-34m3yiyn ran tests.py --changed through /kb-verify although the brief forbade it, since parallel runs load the host into false timeouts).

run: import subprocess,sys;r=subprocess.run(['python3','_tools/rag.py','pack','--root','_self','does a sprint worker running kb-verify run tests.py --changed'],capture_output=True,text=True);ok=r.returncode==0 and 'coverage: good' in r.stdout;print('packs good:',ok);sys.exit(0 if ok else 1)

notes: Checks are planned when a sprint commits it. Planned at the 2026-10-10 whole-backlog triage, which the operator asked to end with every draft planned into a sprint or dropped (sprint 4 of 13, "Headless sprint loop 1: worker brief and role file"); the triage reviewer found it serves the EP-gzr4mmkm fitness test F2: a content sprint from the research queue lands on headless Sonnet workers.
